appearance.harbor_sui_yan: Sui Yan is a fifty-two-year-old mortal woman, the licensed quarantine captain. Silver strands cross one practical braid; dark blue oilcloth sleeves are worn at the cuffs. She has broad working hands, an old small burn on her right thumb, and a patient, unsentimental face. She carries paper quarantine tags and a plain writing board, not magical regalia.
appearance.harbor_han_pei: Han Pei is a twenty-nine-year-old mortal woman and migrant wage clerk. She has a narrow face, short dark hair pinned behind one ear, a faded brown wool jacket and ink-stained left fingertips. A plain cord holds her sleeves above the wrist; her expression is alert and guarded, with warmth appearing when she laughs.
appearance.harbor_yan_su: Yan Su is a thirty-six-year-old mortal man, licensed quay rigger and ordinary rescue foreman. He has a compact strong build, close-cropped black hair, a weathered round face, patched slate-gray work clothes and a clean rope callus across each palm. His tools are ordinary approved rigging tools; he wears no heroic weapon or cultivation aura.
appearance.harbor_qin_shuo: Qin Shuo is a sixty-one-year-old mortal man, custodian of the harbor wage bond. His gray hair is tied neatly, his olive-brown clerk's coat is patched inside the elbows, and small reading spectacles hang on a cord. His lined face looks tired rather than severe; one ink-smudged finger rests on a closed ledger.
appearance.harbor_he_ming: He Ming is a forty-three-year-old mortal woman, salt packer and migrant household delegate. She has a broad wind-reddened face, dark hair with a few gray strands gathered in a low bun, practical indigo wool clothes, cracked salt-working hands and a faded saffron scarf. Her stance is tired, steady and direct. A folded ordinary wage receipt sits in her hand.

definition_note: Root registers these IDs exactly once in the campaign. Harbor part files use empty characters dictionaries to avoid duplicate definitions.
